captions.detailed: A wall-mounted quarter-candy dispenser with a tall, rectangular clear plastic hopper and a gray metal backplate and base housing. A black selector knob sits on the front face above a lower dispensing flap. The top of the hopper features a flat, gray metal refill lid.
captions.instruction: Generate a wall-mounted candy dispenser with a clear rectangular hopper, a flat backplate, and a lower gray mechanism base. Include a rotatable front selector knob, a bottom-hinged retrieval flap, and a top-hinged refill lid.
captions.factory: Construct the backplate, lower housing, and clear hopper using box primitives. Model the selector knob as a cylinder, the retrieval flap as a thin box, and the refill lid as a flat box. Define revolute joints for the top lid and bottom retrieval flap, and a continuous joint for the front selector knob.
